Oliver: Quick sync — Orion Finance asks for streaming, tool calls, enforced structured JSON output, and they sent a security questionnaire.
Emma (SalesEng): Main asks: websocket/SSE streaming for live scoring; function/tool calls for sanitized lookups; schema validation on outputs; BYOK KMS + on-prem.
Raj (Solutions): Recommend SSE with client reconnect. Example snippet:
```js
const ev = new EventSource("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-redwood-1");
ev.onmessage = e => console.log(e.data);
```
Emma: How to validate partial responses?
Raj: We emit incremental chunks keyed with __chunk_id; client assembles then validates. Example fragment: `{"__chunk_id":1,"type":"partial","payload":"{\"merchant\":\"Acme\"}"}`
Leila (Security): Q: customer-managed KMS and no-token-logging?
Emma: BYOK for Private/Dedicated; hosted offers envelope integration for enterprise; no-token-logging path available under enterprise contract (ops approval for retention exceptions).
Oliver: Pricing: estimate for 100 qps baseline, 2M tokens/day, 50k toolcalls?
Raj: If 2M tokens/day ~60M tokens/month. Ballpark reserved plan $12k-$18k/mo plus onboarding; toolcalls minor incremental. Finance to confirm.
deploy-bot: created sales/integrations/1767129999-orion-checklist.md
Oliver: Blockers: corporate proxy with client certs, SAML SSO, on-prem installer checklist.
Raj: mTLS supported on Private; hosted requires proxy in their network to terminate client certs. SAML 2.0 for Console is supported.
Leila: I'll draft questionnaire answers (SOC2, network segmentation, data-at-rest encryption, HSM/KMS options, deletion/retention). ETA EOD tomorrow.
Emma: Action items: Emma -> ask finance for firm pricing; Raj -> sample SSE + toolcall quickstart and one-page runbook; Leila -> security questionnaire draft; Oliver -> send engagement timeline to Orion.
